records.name: Philly Community Wireless
records.summary: Volunteers who build free, community-run Wi-Fi in North Philadelphia. They put antennas on rooftops and in homes so neighbors can get online.
records.what_you_do: Help design, install, or keep the network running, host an antenna at home, or do outreach to find neighbors who want a connection.

locations.label: Norris Square, Fairhill, and Kensington (North Philadelphia)

cost.text: Free Wi-Fi for people the network reaches. Donations are welcome.

first_step.how: Ask for a connection on the Get Connected page, or sign up to volunteer on the Volunteer page.
first_step.basis: Residents in the coverage area can ask for a connection, and the site gives a clear way to volunteer.

records.notes: The homepage says the network currently exists but shows no dated items. The newest dated item is a July 2025 press item on the news page, so the status is probably_active. Member roles and the free service come from a January 2022 article. The Volunteer and Get Connected pages were linked from the homepage but not read directly.

records.name: Mercy Neighborhood Ministries (Mercy Neighbors)
records.summary: A North Philadelphia nonprofit with early learning and after-school programs, adult tutoring, and a meals program. Volunteers can tutor adults or help with Mercy Meals.
records.what_you_do: Tutor adults in reading, math, computer literacy, or GED prep, or help with Mercy Meals.

schedule.text: Tutors are needed two days a week, about three hours in total, between 12 and 4 pm

cost.text: Cost for learners is not stated on the site. Tutoring is volunteer work.

first_step.how: The site does not say how to apply as a tutor, so the way in is unclear. The Adult Education page has the details that are published.
first_step.basis: Volunteer tutors must be 18 or older with a high school diploma or subject knowledge, and the page does not say how to apply.

records.notes: The lead named a computer lab. Neither the homepage nor the Adult Education page describes a computer lab or a public digital class. The only computer item is adult computer literacy tutoring. The events page lists no dated events. The 2022 copyright footer is not dated evidence, so status is unknown. Written as the organization so the owner can decide whether to show it. A 2015 article described a public lab at this site; that claim is not confirmed here.

records.name: Socrates Cafe (Plymouth-Whitemarsh)
records.summary: Informal discussion sessions listed on a Patch community board for the Plymouth-Whitemarsh area, outside the city.
records.notes: Posted June 2014 by William Jeanes Library under the Plymouth-Whitemarsh community board, outside Philadelphia. The post names no meeting place and no website. No Philadelphia listing was found, and the search budget was not spent on it.

records.name: Philly Acts of Science
records.notes: A 2026 citywide citizen science campaign page on SciStarter's own pages domain. It lists time-limited activities tied to the 250th anniversary: stargazing, bird-safe window decals, and Zoom events. It is not a standing group. One search found no separate group website. Owner may want it listed as a seasonal event. The three Zooniverse project pages it links are individual projects and were not checked.

records.name: Center City Jazz Festival
records.notes: An annual music festival in Center City. The page shows the ninth edition, held April 2023, and presented with WRTI 90.1. Each year is an event, not a group a visitor joins. No 2026 evidence is on the page.

records.name: First Degree Consulting
records.notes: A consulting business that works with local governments, nonprofits, and funders. The site shows no community program people can join, so it is hidden under the rule for businesses with no community program.

records.name: Glitter
records.notes: A paid litter cleaning business for city blocks, funded by monthly neighbor pledges. The site also offers a block captain role for neighbors on each block. The site shows no dated items. Not written as a group. Owner may want to decide whether the block captain role belongs in the directory.

leads_only.name: Ours Truly (William Way trans and gender non-conforming social and support initiative)
leads_only.note: Named on William Way's trans programs page as an 18 plus social and support initiative with a bi-weekly newsletter. No days, times, or location shown. Not confirmed as the same group as the Coffee Talk listing. Not checked further.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Science Action
leads_only.note: Surfaced in one search: a civic science group that formed after the 2017 March for Science. Not checked.

notes: Lead by lead. (1) Philly Community Wireless: own site read; the news page shows a July 2025 item. Written as publish, probably_active. (2) Mercy Neighborhood Ministries computer lab: the site and its Adult Education page describe no computer lab or public digital class, only adult computer literacy tutoring. Written as the organization, publish, status unknown, low confidence, so the owner can decide. (3) Tech Tutors: philaliteracy.org failed with a TLS error on three tries; not written. (4) Free Library Techmobile: Free Library page returned 403; only a May 2015 article supports it; not written. (5) KEYSPOT: no own site found; the only source is the May 2015 article; the technical.ly project URL returned the Technical.ly homepage; not written. (6) Socrates Cafe: Patch post from June 2014, Plymouth-Whitemarsh, outside the city: out_of_area. (7) Philly Acts of Science: campaign page on SciStarter's domain with 2026 dated activities; one search found no separate group site; written as not_a_group because it is a time-limited campaign. (8) Philadelphia Homebrew Club: the 2014 article returned 403 per the lead note and was not re-fetched; no own site found; the one search went to Acts of Science, so this lead was skipped. (9) Coffee Talk: the 1degree listing names William Way as host, with a free Wednesday social, but William Way's trans programs page does not name it. Its only named group is Ours Truly, added to leads_only. The listing has no posted date, and the Center must confirm before publishing; not written. (10) Asian Mosaic Fund: a member giving circle that pools donations for grants; no legal form stated and no dated items; not written. The owner needs to decide whether giving circles fall under the private foundation rule. (11) Center City Jazz Festival: annual festival, latest page date April 2023: not_a_group. (12) Community Unity Music Festival: domain does not resolve; not written. (13) CultureBanq: national artist investment initiative with Philadelphia as one of five cities; no Philadelphia program to join; dates given only as years; not written. (14) First Degree Consulting: consulting business with no community program: hide, out_of_scope. (15) Glitter: paid litter cleaning business funded by neighbor pledges, with a block captain role: not_a_group. No rate limiting was seen. Searches used: 1 of 1. Fetches used: 22.
